description: This file contains classes and methods for aggregating responses in a conversational AI system, specifically handling Large Language Model (LLM) responses, user inputs, and conversation context. It defines base and specialized classes for user and assistant response aggregation, managing message flow, function calls, and event handling within a dialogue pipeline.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for user message aggregation behavior, including turn strategies, mute strategies, and timeouts.

classes.name: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for assistant response aggregation, notably whether to expect stripped words.

classes.name: UserTurnStoppedMessage
classes.description: Data class representing a message indicating a user turn has stopped, including content, timestamp, and optional user ID.

classes.name: AssistantTurnStoppedMessage
classes.description: Data class representing a message indicating an assistant turn has stopped, including content and timestamp.

classes.name: AssistantThoughtMessage
classes.description: Data class representing an assistant's internal thought message, including content and timestamp.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregator
classes.description: Base class for aggregating LLM responses and managing conversation context, providing methods for message handling and frame pushing.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregator
classes.description: Specialized aggregator for user input, managing turn start/stop, message aggregation, and context updates.

classes.name: LLMAssistantAggregator
classes.description: Specialized aggregator for assistant responses, handling response start/end, function calls, images, and internal thoughts.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Container class for pairing user and assistant aggregators, facilitating simultaneous context updates.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Pushes the current message aggregation to the context and resets the internal buffer.

methods.name: aggregation_string
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string of the current message aggregation.

methods.name: _handle_llm_start
methods.description: Handles the start of an LLM full response, increasing the response count and triggering turn start event.

methods.name: _handle_llm_end
methods.description: Handles the end of an LLM full response, decreasing the response count and triggering turn stop event.

methods.name: _handle_text
methods.description: Processes a text frame, appending its text to the aggregation if a response is active.

methods.name: _handle_thought_start
methods.description: Handles the start of an internal assistant thought, resetting the thought buffer and recording context.

methods.name: _handle_thought_text
methods.description: Appends text to the current internal thought buffer.

methods.name: _handle_thought_end
methods.description: Finalizes the internal thought, optionally adds it to the context, and triggers an event.

methods.name: _trigger_assistant_turn_started
methods.description: Records timestamp and triggers the 'turn started' event for the assistant.

methods.name: _trigger_assistant_turn_stopped
methods.description: Finalizes the current response, adds it to context, and triggers the 'turn stopped' event.
